entries.source: deal darkness damage equal to your 350%% of your spellpower to a target, and, if it kills the target, restores 15% of max hp and all resources (except paradox and equilibrium)
entries.target: 对目标造成相当于你法术强度 350% 的暗影伤害，若击杀目标，则按各自上限的 15% 恢复生命值和所有资源（紊乱值和失衡值除外）。

entries.source:
When you deal a critical strike in melee, you send out a cone of acid, dealing %d damage to all enemies and melting walls you hit.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
每次近战暴击时，将释放一股锥形酸液，对范围内所有敌人造成 %d 点酸性伤害，并融化被击中的墙壁。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source:
You fire a special, electrically charged shot with your steamgun(s) at a spot within range.
		When each shot reaches its target, it bursts into electrified shrapnel within radius %d, which shocks each target hit and deals %d%% weapon damage as lightning.
		Shocked targets lose up to %d non-magical effects (for the first shot that hits).
		This talent does not use ammo.
entries.target:
你用蒸汽枪向射程内的一处位置进行一次特殊的带电射击。
		每发子弹抵达目标位置时，都会爆裂成电化弹片，波及半径 %d 格，电击命中的每个目标，并对其造成 %d%% 武器伤害的闪电伤害。
		被电击的目标失去至多 %d 个物理或精神增益效果（仅第一发命中时生效）。
		本技能不消耗弹药。

entries.source:
Allows the use of Technomancy spells.
		Grants a magical steam reserve that regenerates %d steam per 10 mana spent.
		Grants Spellpower based on current steam level (currently %d; %d%% steam filled).
		Outside of combat, you relax and let your steam reserve slowly wither away.
		#{italic}#Metal Arcane Power!#{normal}#
entries.target:
允许使用科技法术。
		获得一个魔法蒸汽储备，施放消耗法力且不消耗蒸汽的主动法术时，每消耗10点法力值获得 %d 蒸汽。
		根据当前蒸汽值获得法术强度（目前 %d； 蒸汽储量 %d%%）。
		在战斗外，你放松了控制，蒸汽储备会逐渐消退。
		#{italic}#金属奥术力量！#{normal}#

entries.source:
Deploy a defensive emplacement around you, summoning 2 guardian turrets in adjacent tiles for %d turns. Guardian turrets redirect %d%% of all damage taken by other adjacent allies (other than fellow guardian turrets) to themselves, and each is armed with a powerful turret capable of firing piercing bullets.
			Guardian Turrets gain %0.2f ranks in Steamgun Mastery based on your Hunker Down talent level.
entries.target:
在身边部署防御阵地，在相邻格召唤 2 个守卫炮台，持续 %d 回合。守卫炮台会将身边其他盟友（不含其他守卫炮台）所受全部伤害的 %d%% 转移到自己身上，并且各自装备有能发射贯穿子弹的强力炮台。
			守卫炮台获得 %0.2f 级蒸汽枪掌握，等级取决于你的炮台守卫技能等级。
